author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯನು ಹಿಂದಿಡದೆ ನಡೆಯುತಿರು
ನೊಂದ ಮನಗಳಿಗೆಂದು ಶಾಂತಿಯನು ನೀಡು
ಹಿಂದೆ ನಡೆದಿರುವಂಥ ಘಟನೆಗಳೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಹು
ಮುಂದಿನಕೆ ನಾಂದಿಯದೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Having stepped forward, do not step back; keep going;
give peace to minds that are hurting;
the events of the past stand as witness,
and they are the overture to what comes next, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Once you have set out, keep going, and comfort those who suffer along the way. The past is both evidence and the prelude to the future.
